products.body:
A deep, rich medium roast taken to the very edge of second crack. This process unlocks a captivating interplay of the sweetness of dark fruit and the richness of toffee. An adventure in every sip.

Rich, robust, and smooth sailing, CHASING TIDES brings you favourable winds in every cup. This adventurer’s blend is lovingly crafted by Canada’s first fairtrade and organic roastery, a 100% Canadian worker-owned co-op that collaborates with long-time small producer partners for coffee that goes with the flow in true seafaring spirit.
